glide.description: Glide the pointer to the target along a humanised trajectory instead of moving in a single step.

ref.description: Optional `@e<N>` ref allocated by the last observation. Mutually exclusive with `selector` and with `x`/`y`.

settle_ms.description: Wait after the mouse move so hover-triggered UI can settle.

tab_id.description: Target tab. Defaults to the Agent Window's active tab.

x.description: Viewport-relative X coordinate (CSS pixels). When both `x` and `y` are supplied the mouse moves straight to this point without resolving an element; both must be given together and neither may be combined with `ref`/`selector`.

KeyModifier.description: Keyboard modifier flags. Multiple flags may be combined; the extension folds them into CDP's bitfield (`alt=1, ctrl=2, meta=4, shift=8`).
